item.content:encoded: I love the poem at the end. Ties the whole thing together perfectly. Honestly, I kinda want to see this become a whole series detailing what happened and how the Foundation is trying to fix it. You've already created several compelling characters and a solid feeling of suspense, all you'd need is a few more tales and you could create a superior halloween/fall series.
